fact: The National Financial Ombud Scheme takes consumer complaints about banking fraud, most of it mobile and digital banking, and closed 3,651 fraud cases in 2025, per the ombud.

The National Financial Ombud South Africa Banking Division resolved disputes in 2025 and reports that mobile banking and internet banking fraud were the highest complaint generators, 39% of all cases received.

fact: The National Financial Ombud Scheme's Banking Division, reporting in its annual report for 2024, took 15,412 banking complaints that year, including mobile banking fraud, phishing and vishing complaints under digital banking.
